questions.question: REQ-RST-001 says every flip-flop resets asynchronously, but REQ-RST-005/RST-009 and 'first edge after release' imply synchronous release handling. Is i_rst_n release synchronised internally or asserted/released asynchronously relative to i_clk?
Does 'no transmit byte accepted while i_rst_n = 0' with o_tx_ready = 1 conflict with the handshake definition that a transfer happens when i_tx_valid and o_tx_ready are both 1?
